name: ca-cioos_6652a7a9-d27f-4cbe-ac04-435c238e991d1
notes: This dataset presents a time series of water level measurements made by an RBR Solo pressure sensor deployed by the Hakai Institute near the Calvert Island Research Station in the coastal region of Choke Pass. Sea Pressure collected by the instrument located just above the sea bed was then corrected to subtract the atmospheric pressure based on the Hakai Pruth Dock Weather Station. The resulting sea pressure was then converted to a depth with the Gibbs Sea Water TEOS-10 toolbox and subtracted by the mean water level measured at the location.

notes_translated.en: This dataset presents a time series of water level measurements made by an RBR Solo pressure sensor deployed by the Hakai Institute near the Calvert Island Research Station in the coastal region of Choke Pass. Sea Pressure collected by the instrument located just above the sea bed was then corrected to subtract the atmospheric pressure based on the Hakai Pruth Dock Weather Station. The resulting sea pressure was then converted to a depth with the Gibbs Sea Water TEOS-10 toolbox and subtracted by the mean water level measured at the location.
notes_translated.fr: Ce jeu de données présente une série chronologique de mesures du niveau d'eau effectuées par un capteur de pression RBR Solo déployé par l'Institut Hakai près de la station de recherche de Calvert Island, dans la région côtière de Choke Pass. La pression de la mer collectée par l'instrument situé juste au-dessus du fond marin a ensuite été corrigée pour soustraire la pression atmosphérique sur la base de la station météorologique du quai Hakai Pruth. La pression de la mer résultante a ensuite été convertie en profondeur à l'aide de la boîte à outils Gibbs Sea Water TEOS-10 et soustraite par le niveau d'eau moyen mesuré sur place.

description_translated.en: The Canadian Integrated Ocean Observing System (CIOOS) Pacific is the regional hub of the National CIOOS for ocean data aggregation on Canada’s west coast.
